notes.title: bugs bugs bugs bugs bugs bugs bugs bugs
notes.content:
- Fixed player graphic not switching to Hounderick's graphic in crocodile cutscene when party leader isn't Hounderick
- Added new code for Weapon Shop that gives you an item I left unused for a very long [b]TIME[/b]
- Added small detail to a certain quest enemy's graphic
- Made some enemy encounters wait for the proper screen brightness before they attempt to beat you up in combat (in case you saved near them and they spot you before the fadein effect finished)

notes.title: Steam Screenshot added to record all of Hounderick's crimes
notes.content:
- Added the steam screenshot functionality from the steam overlay but not the steam overlay itself (cuz it doesnt work in vx ace)

You can change the screenshot key in the menu options in the game or in the game.ini file
and decide whether you want the screenshot to save in steam or in the game root folder.
(F12 doesn't work for now because it's set as the key that immediately returns you to the title screen in rpg maker.)

- Fixed hounderick turning into a newspaper if he leaves the train with a costume on.

notes.title: Navigation Arrow added to strike fear into any wandering bug
notes.content:
- Added Advanced Navigation
It's an arrow rotating around Hounderick pointing him where he should go to continue the story. It's set off by default but you can activate it in the options menu. If you are in the options and you press R or A (depends on your keybind) you can customize the arrow's color and graphic.

- Fixed Objective not showing anything at a certain point in the story
- Added a few more battle backgrounds in the story
- Made the randomized names for the canine enemies appear in battles now too

notes.title: Demo savefiles are now compatible with fullversion + more languages for demo
notes.content:
Demo savefiles now work with the fullversion: 

- You get a funny hat if the story content of the demo has been completed in that save.
- The savefile now has an indicator that it's from the demo on the savescreen (Save again if you don't see it.)

As for the demo:
- 2 more languages added. Simplified chinese and german (german isn't available for the fullversion yet cause that takes way longer to translate than the demo.)
- Added Cutscene skipping

Note that older versions of demo savefiles will not be compatible.

Bug fixes for the fullversion:
 - Fixed Hounderick pretending he shot the laser attack when it was actually salamonty.
 - Fixed one of the frequent speeches for plants being set to check for story progression instead
 - Fixed getting possibly softlocked in newspaper quest

(Bug I just discovered but may consider leaving since it's funny: if you already have the battle addict trophy in the fullversion but transfer in a demo savefile, you will be presented with a free frozen pizza in that demo save. Eat it well.)

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Translation out

Hounderick is bilingual now, we are all doomed.

Also, hurray, simplified chinese translation is out!
(translated by 三角含树)

+ Some new stuff:

- Added post-game hidden boss in lionhill city

(Also you can set the font of the chinese translation in the game.ini file if you feel like it.)
